items.title: Base change along an extension of a separably closed field induces a bijection on irreducible components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an extension of fields k'/k with k separably algebraically closed and a scheme X over k, the lemma shows that the base change morphism induces a bijection between irreducible components (statement lines 1523-1529). The proof is a two-step reduction: separably closedness of k makes the extension k' geometrically irreducible over k, hence the spectrum of k' is geometrically irreducible as a scheme, and then the base change is recognized as the product of X with that geometrically irreducible factor, so the general bijection statement for products with a geometrically irreducible factor applies (proof lines 1531-1538). The claim is H2: two cited inputs with the identification of the base change as a product as the connecting observation, and nothing referred to the reader.
